prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member in the AmCham Argentina member directory (nuestros socios)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Chamber membership signals standing among leading multinationals and local business peers.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the AmCham Argentina members page and enter the company name in its member search.
prompts.found_when: The company appears as a listed AmCham Argentina member.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean name search returns no member entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member directory cannot be searched or the page is unreadable.

prompts.question: Does the company have an employer profile with employee ratings on Computrabajo Argentina?
prompts.why_it_matters: Crowdsourced employee reviews reveal how the company is perceived as a workplace.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Computrabajo company search box and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A company profile appears with employee evaluations or ratings.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no company profile for the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search cannot be executed, the name is too common to match, or the page is unreadable.

prompts.question: Do corporate notices for this company appear in the Boletín Oficial de la Provincia de Buenos Aires?
prompts.why_it_matters: Gazette notices confirm incorporation, bylaw changes and officer appointments.

source.name: Boletín Oficial de la Provincia de Buenos Aires

prompts.how_to_query: Use the gazette's search page and enter the company name in the words field.
prompts.found_when: One or more legal notices naming the company are returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no notice for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page cannot be reached, results are illegible, or the name is too common to match.

prompts.question: Does the company have a company profile with open job postings on Bumeran Argentina?
prompts.why_it_matters: Active hiring pages show growth areas and confirm the company is operating at scale.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Bumeran company suggestion search and type the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears with a profile and job postings.
prompts.not_found_when: No company profile is returned for a clean name search.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The company lookup cannot be searched or returns an unreadable result.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member of CESSI, the Argentine software industry chamber?
prompts.why_it_matters: Sector membership evidences a genuine software business and industry recognition.

source.name: CESSI - Cámara de la Industria Argentina del Software

prompts.how_to_query: Search the CESSI site or its member pages for the company name.

prompts.not_found_when: No CESSI member entry is found for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The CESSI member pages cannot be searched or loaded.

prompts.question: Does the company appear among the transport operators authorised by CNRT?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only CNRT-authorised carriers may legally provide passenger or freight transport.

source.name: Comisión Nacional de Regulación del Transporte (CNRT)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the CNRT habilitated-company consultation and submit the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company is returned as a habilitated transport operator.
prompts.not_found_when: The consultation returns no authorisation for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The consultation form fails or the listing cannot be read.

prompts.not_found_when: No CNV record is found for the company.
